newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti to co-opt two int'l board members.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti to co-opt two int'l board members.

text.p: Troubled Italian high-tech group Olivetti will co-opt on to its board two new members in coming weeks to represent international investors, CEO Roberto Colannini told a London analysts' meeting on Friday.
His statement was confirmed by a company source in Italy.
International funds own up to 70 percent of Olivetti's capital. They, and especially British fund managers, have been pressing in recent weeks for places on the board to represent their interests.
Olivetti said this week the board had assured major shareholders it was open to receive proposals on possible candidates in line with Olivetti's status as a public company.
